international.title: Flagship UK gigafactory plan in turmoil after it loses second builder in five months
international.summary: Tata-owned Agratas plant to build EV batteries for sister company Jaguar Land Rover seen as crucial for long-term health of British car industry One of the UK’s flagship electric vehicle battery projects has been thrown into turmoil after its second building contractor in five months walked away, adding to questions over when Jaguar Land Rover cars will use British-made batteries. The £5.2bn gigafactory in Bridgwater, Somerset, is being built by Agratas, to provide batteries for Britain’s largest automotive employer, its sister company. Agratas and Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) are both part of Indian conglomerate Tata Group. Continue reading...
